faqs.a:
(a)
Any declaration of a civil emergency, emergency, or disaster by the city manager shall
               be promptly filed with the city clerk, and the city manager shall notify as soon as
               possible the city council. The public shall be notified of such a declaration through
               general dissemination to the news media, posting on the city website or other means
               of publicity as intended to advise the general public.
(b)
Any order or proclamation declaring, continuing, or terminating a disaster or emergency
               or civil emergency shall be filed promptly with the Colorado Division of Homeland
               Security & Emergency Management and the Office of Emergency Management at Jefferson
               County or Adams County (as appropriate).
(c)
The form of the declaration may follow a template previously created by the community
               resilience coordinator or any form as deemed appropriate by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 2, 12-5-2022)
